title.zh: 【韩国金融委员会召开加密交易平台会议，强调优化黑客防护与用户资产保护】
title.en: 【韩国金融委员会召开加密交易平台会议，强调优化黑客防护与用户资产保护】

current_state.zh: South Korea's Financial Services Commission met with domestic crypto exchanges on November 2, citing the Binance attack to press for stronger hack defenses and user asset protection, and pushed platforms to hold more than 80% of user crypto assets in cold wallets — a threshold Upbit, Bithumb, Coinone, DigitalX and Gopax already broadly meet.
